rationale.scope: Budgets were fixed from documented guarantees and peer ceilings before any Schema capacity measurement; they are never tuned to an observed result. docs/schema/README.md publishes no performance numbers ('performance qualification and release evidence' is listed as remaining work).
rationale.workload: Capture is the only runtime hot path against PostgreSQL (compare, plan and serialize are in-memory; the deployment coordinator is a low-frequency journal). Eight application modules of 32 related tables (enum, domain, foreign keys, checks, indexes, row security, a view and a function) are captured repeatedly while fixed-cardinality application DML keeps the database live, as an operator or Studio would capture a running system. Every capture must reproduce the baseline fingerprint (README: the canonical fingerprint excludes transient OIDs and normalizes order).
rationale.durationAndRepeats: Two clean exact-candidate runs of 30 minutes each, the minimum every other expansion capacity gate requires.
rationale.offeredRates: 16 relation captures/s and 2 catalog captures/s, each catalog capture holding two pooled connections (README: 'The pool must admit two simultaneous capture connections'); application DML at 80 updates/s.
rationale.minimumAcceptedPerSecond: 95% of each fixed offered rate (Edge maximumSkippedFraction 0.05, the strictest peer schedule-skip ceiling).
rationale.maximumRejectedFraction: 0.02 for captures: catalogue attestation documentedly fails closed with SchemaConcurrentDdlException when catalogue rows change concurrently (catalogue-attestation.md: 'unrelated catalogue changes may also reject capture'). The ceiling equals Search's maximumMaintenancePruneRejectionFraction for its analogous fail-closed lock conflicts. Application DML has no admission control: zero.
rationale.maximumErrors: Zero for every operation; a fingerprint mismatch aborts the run.
rationale.capture-relations.maximumP99Milliseconds: 1000 ms: Studio's GET /schema runs this capture under QueryTimeoutSeconds (default 10 s); a tenth of that deadline leaves headroom for serialization and the reply.
rationale.capture-catalog.maximumP99Milliseconds: 5000 ms: catalogue capture attests 28 global catalogues and may retry up to three times inside its own deadline; half the Studio deadline, equal to Search's read ceiling (maximumReadP99Milliseconds 5000).
rationale.application-write.maximumP99Milliseconds: 500 ms: the background DML is a single-row durable update and inherits the Documents save ceiling; a breach means captures were measured on an unhealthy fixture.
rationale.maximumOwnedRelationBytes: 1 GiB: Search's owned-relation ceiling for a fixed-cardinality corpus.
rationale.maximumLateOwnedGrowthBytesPerMinute: 16 MiB/min: Documents' fixed-cardinality maximumLateGrowthBytesPerMinute; capture writes nothing and the DML updates a fixed row set, so late growth may only be bounded MVCC churn.
rationale.maximumDatabaseBytes: 8 GiB: the Search and Documents whole-database ceiling.
